GROWTH.over_pattern: When growth energy is dominant, you run on forward motion. The challenge isn't starting — it's stopping. Rest can feel like a betrayal of your own ambition, and stillness can look like stagnation.
GROWTH.under_pattern: When growth energy is scarce, you may struggle to begin — mentally and physically. Getting started can feel like pushing through concrete.
practices: Take a 10-minute walk with no goal. Just movement, not exercise.
Say 'no' to one small thing this week. Notice how it feels.
Try a slow, aimless stretch before bed. Just feeling, not fixing.

SPARK.over_pattern: When spark energy dominates, you run hot. Ideas, emotions, and enthusiasm arrive at full volume. The risk is pouring so much outward that little remains for you.
SPARK.under_pattern: When spark energy is scarce, motivation can feel distant. You don't perform enthusiasm — your warmth is quieter than most.
practices: Ten quiet minutes before checking your phone in the morning.
Notice one small pleasure today. Say it out loud.
Skip scheduling anything after 9pm for one week. Just try it.

GROUND.over_pattern: When ground energy dominates, you become the person others lean on. The risk: carrying so much for so long that you forget what your own weight feels like.
GROUND.under_pattern: When ground energy is scarce, you may feel unmoored — always slightly off balance, even when everything looks fine from outside.
practices: Eat one meal a day slowly, sitting down, no screen.
Stand barefoot on real ground for 5 minutes.
Eat at the same time for three days in a row.

EDGE.over_pattern: When edge energy dominates, you cut through the noise. The risk: winning the point and losing the room — or turning that sharpness inward.
EDGE.under_pattern: When edge energy is scarce, you may avoid conflict even when it's the right call. Boundaries can feel harder to set than they should.
practices: Three slow, deep breaths before opening email.
Clear one small surface today — a desk, a drawer, a list.
Spend 10 minutes outside, even if it's cold.

FLOW.over_pattern: When flow energy dominates, you adapt easily. The risk: never quite committing — because everything is still possible.
FLOW.under_pattern: When flow energy is scarce, you want to know where things are going before you move. That caution is useful — until it becomes a cage.
practices: Drink a full glass of water before every meal.
Take one full rest day this month with no output.
Sit quietly with an unresolved question for 5 minutes. No answer needed.
